cnd23:187.3: abbhantaradhātukopavasena vā sītaṃ hoti, bahiddhā utuvasena vā sītaṃ vā hoti.
cnd23:187.5: abbhantaradhātukopavasena vā uṇhaṃ hoti, bahiddhā utuvasena vā uṇhaṃ hoti,
cnd23:188.2: ‘vātā’ti puratthimā vātā pacchimā vātā uttarā vātā dakkhiṇā vātā sarajā vātā arajā vātā sītā vātā uṇhā vātā parittā vātā adhimattā vātā kāḷavātā’ verambavātā pakkhavātā supaṇṇavātā tālapaṇṇavātā vidhupanavātā.
cnd23:189.1: sabbānipetāni abhisambhavitvāti, abhibhavitvā ajjhottharitvā pariyādiyitvā madditvāti
cnd23:189.2: sabbāni petāni abhisambhavitvā eko care khaggavisāṇakappo’.
cnd23:192.7: kathaṃ so paccekasambuddho āguṃ na karotīti nāgo:
cnd23:192.8: ‘āgu’ vuccati pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṃkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā.
cnd23:194.1: evaṃ so paccekasambuddho āguṃ nakarotīti nāgo.
cnd23:195.1: kathaṃ so paccekasambuddho na gacchatīti nāgo:
cnd23:195.14: na vaggehi dhammehi yāyati nīyati vuyhati saṃharīyati.
cnd23:195.15: evaṃ so paccekasambuddho na gacchatīti nāgo.
cnd23:196.1: kathaṃ so paccekasambuddho na āgacchatīti nāgo:
cnd23:196.2: sotāpattimaggena se kilesā pahīnā, te kilese na puneti, na pacceti, na paccāgacchati,
cnd23:196.5: arahattamaggena se kilesā pahīnā te kilese na puneti, na pacceti, na paccāgacchati,
cnd23:196.6: evaṃ so paccekasambuddho na āgacchatīti nāgo.
cnd23:197.1: nāgova yūthāni vivajjayitvāti: yathā so hatthināgo yūthāni vivajjayitvā parivajjetvā abhinivajjetvā eko araññe vanamajjhogāhetvā carati irīyati pāleti yapeti yāpeti. paccekasambuddhopi gaṇaṃ vivajjetvā parivajjetvā abhinivajjetvā eko araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevati, appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni.
cnd23:197.2: so eko gacchati, eko tiṭṭhati, eko nisīdati, eko seyyaṃ kappeti, eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati, eko paṭikkamati, eko raho nisīdati, eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, eko carati viharati irīyati vatteti pāleti yapeti ‘yāpetīti
cnd23:198.1: sañjātakhandho padumī uḷāroti: yathā so hatthināgo sañjātakhandho sattaratano vā hoti aṭṭharatano vā. paccekasambuddhopi sañjātakhandho asekkhena sīlakkhandhena asekkhena samādhikkhandhena asekkhena paññākkhandhena asekkhena vimuttikkhandhena asekkhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena.
cnd23:198.2: yathā so hatthināgo padumī. paccekasambuddhopi sattabhi bojjhaṅgapupphehi padumī. satisambojjhaṅgapupphena dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgapupphena viriyasambojjhaṅgapupphena pītisambojjhaṅgapupphena passaddhisambojjhaṅgapupphena samādhisambojjhaṅgapupphena upekkhāsambojjhaṅgapupphena
cnd23:198.3: yathā so hatthināgo uḷāro thāmena balena javena sūrena paccekasambuddhopi uḷāro sīlena samādhinā paññāya vimuttiyā vimuttiñāṇadassanoti-
cnd23:199.1: yathābhirantaṃ viharaṃ araññeti: yathā so hatthināgo yathābhirantaṃ araññe viharati, paccekasambuddhopi yathābhirantaṃ araññe viharati,
cnd23:202.1: aṭṭhānataṃ saṅgaṇikāratassa yaṃ phassaye sāmayikaṃ vimuttinti: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā.
cnd23:202.2: “sovatānanda bhikkhu saṃgaṇikārāmo saṃgaṇikārato saṃgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto, gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito gaṇārāmataṃ anuyutto yaṃ taṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhasukhaṃ, tassa sukhassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti
cnd23:202.4: so ca kho so ānanda, bhikkhu eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
cnd23:202.5: yaṃ taṃ nekkhammasukhaṃ pavivekasukhaṃ upasamasukhaṃ sambodhasukhaṃ, tassa sukhassa nikāmalābhī bhavissati akicchalābhī akasiralābhīti
cnd23:202.7: so vatānanda bhikkhu saṅgaṇikārāmo saṅgaṇikarato saṃgaṇikārāmataṃ anuyutto gaṇārāmo gaṇarato gaṇasammudito gaṇārāmataṃ anuyutto sāmayikaṃ vā santaṃ ceto vimutti. upasampajja viharissati asāmayikaṃ vā akuppanti
cnd23:202.9: yo ca kho so ānanda bhikkhu eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho viharati, tassetaṃ bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ sāmayikaṃ vā santaṃ ceto vimuttiṃ upasampajja viharissati, asāvayikaṃ vā akuppanti ṭhānametaṃ vijjatī”ti.
cnd23:202.10: aṭṭhānaṃ saṃgaṇikāratassa yaṃ phassaye sāmayikaṃ vimuttiṃ.
cnd23:203.4: so paccekasambuddho suriyassa gottañātako gottabandhu, tasmā paccekasambuddho ādiccabandhu.
cnd23:203.5: ādiccabandhussa vaconisammāti ādiccabandhussa vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusiṭṭhiṃ sutvā suṇitvā uggahetvā upadhārayitvā upalakkhayitvāti
cnd23:206.2: “idha assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido, ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto, rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ,
cnd23:206.6: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassatī, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ,
cnd23:206.7: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahaṇaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ gāho patiṭṭhāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesagāho viparītagāho vipallāsagāho micchāgāho ayāthāvatasmiṃ yāthāvatanti gāho yāvatā dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni
cnd23:206.9: diṭṭhīvisūkāni upātivattoti diṭṭhivisūkāni upātivatto atikkanto samatikkanto vītivattoti
cnd23:207.1: patto niyāmaṃ paṭiladdhamaggoti ‘niyāmā’ vuccanti cattāro maggā
cnd23:207.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṃkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
cnd23:207.4: catūhi ariyamaggehi samannāgato niyāmaṃ patto sampatto adhigato phassito sacchikatoti
cnd23:207.6: paṭiladdhamaggoti laddhamaggo paṭiladdhamaggo adhigatamaggo phassitamaggo sacchikatamaggoti
cnd23:208.1: uppannañāṇomhi anaññaneyyoti tassa paccekasambuddhassa ñāṇaṃ uppannaṃ samuppannaṃ nibbattaṃ abhinibbattaṃ pātubhūtaṃ
cnd23:208.2: ‘sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā’ti ñāṇaṃ uppannaṃ samuppannaṃ nibbattaṃ abhinibbattaṃ pātubhūtaṃ,
cnd23:208.5: ‘yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma’nti ñāṇaṃ uppannaṃ samuppannaṃ nibbattaṃ abhinibbattaṃ pātubhūtanti
cnd23:208.7: ‘anaññaneyyoti: so paccekasambuddho na paraneyyo, na parappattiyo, na parappaccayo na parapaṭibaddhagū’ yathābhūtaṃ janāti! passati asammūḷho sampajāno patissato
cnd23:208.8: ‘sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā’ti paraneyyo na parappattiyo na parapaṭibaddhagū’ yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati asammūḷho sampajāno patissato
cnd23:208.11: ‘yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamma’nti na paraneyyo na parappattiyo na parappaccayo na parapaṭibaddhagū’ yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati asammūḷho sampajāno patissatoti
cnd23:211.3: sā loluppā taṇhā paccekasambuddhassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāva katā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
cnd23:212.2: paccaya paṭisedhanasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu, iriyāpathasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu, sāmantajappanasaṅkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu.
cnd23:213.2: “idha gahapatikā bhikkhuṃ nimantenti: cīvara piṇḍapāta senāsana gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārehi so pāpiccho icchāpakato atthiko cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ bhīyokamyataṃ upādāya cīvaraṃ paccakkhāti, piṇḍapātaṃ paccakkhāti, senāsanaṃ paccakkhāti, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paccakkhāti,
cnd23:213.5: etaṃ sāruppaṃ: yaṃ samaṇo susānā vā saṅkārakūṭā vā pāpanikā vā nantakāni uccinitvā saṃghāṭikaṃ katvā dhāreyya.
cnd23:213.7: etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo uñchācariyāya piṇḍiyālopena jīvikaṃ kappeyya.
cnd23:213.9: etaṃ sāruppaṃ: yaṃ samaṇo rukkhamūliko vā assa sosāniko vā abbhokāsiko vā.
cnd23:213.11: etaṃ sāruppaṃ yaṃ samaṇo pūtimuttena vā haritakīkhaṇḍena vā osadhaṃ kareyyāti
cnd23:213.12: tadupādāya lūkhaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāreti, lūkhaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjati, lūkhaṃ senāsanaṃ paṭisevati, lūkhaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paṭisevati.
cnd23:213.14: ‘ayaṃ samaṇo appiccho santuṭṭho pavivitto asaṃsaṭṭho āraddhaviriyo dhutavādo’ti
cnd23:213.17: tiṇṇaṃ sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputtobahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati saddhāya sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati. deyyadhammassa sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati, dakkhiṇeyyānaṃ sammukhībhāvā saddho kulaputto bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavati.
cnd23:213.18: tumhākaṃ cevāyaṃ saddhā atthi deyyadhammo ca saṃvijjati ahaṃ ca paṭiggāhako.
cnd23:213.19: sacehaṃ na paṭiggahessāmi evaṃ tumhe puññena paribāhirā bhavissatha,
cnd23:213.22: tadupādāya bahumpi cīvaraṃ paṭigaṇhāti bahumpi piṇḍapātaṃ paṭigaṇhāti bahumpi senāsanaṃ paṭigaṇhāti bahumpi gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paṭigaṇhāti,
cnd23:213.23: yā evarūpā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanaṃ kuhitatattaṃ,
cnd23:214.2: idhekacco pāpiccho icchāpakato sambhāvanādhippāyo, evaṃ maṃ jano sambhāvissatīti gamanaṃ saṇṭhapeti ṭhānaṃ saṇṭhapeti nisajjaṃ saṇṭhapeti sayanaṃ saṇṭhapeti paṇidhāya gacchati, paṇidhāya tiṭṭhati, paṇidhāya nisīdati, paṇidhāya seyyaṃ kappeti, samāhito viya gacchati, samāhito viya tiṭṭhati, samāhito viya nisīdati, samāhito viya seyyaṃ kappeti āpāthakajjhāyi ca hoti
cnd23:214.3: yā evarūpā iriyāpathassa aṭṭhapanā ṭhapanā saṇṭhapanā bhākuṭikā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ,
cnd23:215.2: idhekacco pāpiccho icchāpakato sambhāvanādhippāyo evaṃ maṃ jano sambhāvessatīti ariyadhammasannissitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati.
cnd23:215.3: yo evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ dhāreti, so samaṇo mahesakkhoti bhaṇati,
cnd23:215.11: āyogaṃ dhāreti, so samaṇo mahesakkhoti bhaṇati.
cnd23:215.12: yassa evarūpo upajjhāyo so samaṇo mahesakkhoti, bhaṇati,
cnd23:215.33: rukkhamūle vasati, so samaṇo mahesakkhoti bhaṇati,
cnd23:216.1: athavā korañjikakorañjiko bhākuṭikabhākuṭiko kuhakakuhako lapakalapako mukhasaṃbhāvito ayaṃ samaṇo imāsaṃ evarūpānaṃ santānaṃ vihārasamāpattīnaṃ labhīti. tādisaṃ gambhīraṃ gūḷhaṃ nipuṇaṃ paṭicchannaṃ lokuttaraṃ suññatāpaṭisaññuttaṃ kathaṃ katheti.
cnd23:216.2: yā evarūpā bhākuṭitā bhākuṭiyaṃ kuhanā. kuhāyanā kuhitattaṃ, idaṃ sāmantajappanasaṃkhātaṃ kuhanavatthu.
cnd23:216.3: tassa paccekasambuddhassa imāni tīṇi kuhanavatthūni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭippassaddhāni abhabbuppattikāni ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāni,
cnd23:217.3: sā pipāsā taṇhā tassa paccekasambuddhassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā,
cnd23:218.3: kasāvoti’ rāgo kasāvo, doso kasāvo, moho kasāvo, kodho upanā ho makkho palāso …pe… sabbākusalābhisaṃkhārā kasāvā.
cnd23:218.4: mohoti: dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ pubbante aññāṇaṃ aparante aññāṇaṃ, pubbantāparante aññāṇaṃ, idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu aññāṇaṃ,
cnd23:218.5: yaṃ evarūpaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho appaṭivedho asaṃgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā apaccavekkhanā apaccakkhakammaṃ dummejjhaṃ bālyaṃ asampajaññaṃ moho pamoho sammoho avijjā avijjogho avijjāyogo avijjānusayo avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ avijjālaṅgi moho akusalamūlaṃ.
cnd23:218.6: tassa paccekasambuddhassa makkho ca moho ca vantā saṃvantā niddhantā pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭippassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhāti
cnd23:219.2: yo rāgo sārāgo …pe… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ”
cnd23:219.3: sabbaloketi: sabbaapāya loke sabba manussaloke sabba devaloke sabbabandhaloke sabbadhātuloke sabbaāyatanaloke.
cnd23:219.4: nirāsaso sabbaloke bhavitvāti sabbaloke nirāsaso bhavitvā. nittaṇhobhavitvā, nippipāso bhavitvāti
cnd23:222.2: ‘pāpasahāyo’ vuccati “yo so sahāyo dasavatthukāya micchādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato’.
cnd23:222.3: natthi dinnaṃ natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ. kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paroloko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imaṃ ca lokaṃ paraṃ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī”ti
cnd23:223.1: anatthadassiṃ visame niviṭṭhanti: ‘anatthadassī, vuccati yo so sahāyo dasavatthukāya micchādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato’.
cnd23:223.2: natthi dinnaṃ natthi yiṭṭhaṃ …pe… ye imaṃ ca lokaṃ paraṃ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
cnd23:223.3: visame niviṭṭhanti: visame kāyakamme niviṭṭhaṃ, visame vacīkamme niviṭṭhaṃ, visame manokamme niviṭṭhaṃ, visame pāṇātipāte niviṭṭhaṃ, visame adinnādāne niviṭṭhaṃ, visame kāmesu micchācāre niviṭṭhaṃ, visame musāvāde niviṭṭhaṃ, visamāya pisunāya vācāya niviṭṭhaṃ, visamāya pharusāya vācāya niviṭṭhaṃ, visame vyāpāde niviṭṭhaṃ, visamāya micchādiṭṭhiyā niviṭṭhaṃ, visamesu saṅkhāresu niviṭṭhaṃ, visamesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu niviṭṭhaṃ, visamesu pañcasu nīvaraṇesu niviṭṭhaṃ viniviṭṭhaṃ, sattaṃ allīnaṃ upagataṃ ajjhositaṃ adhimuttanti
cnd23:224.2: kāme esati gavesati pariyesati taccarito tabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappono tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo sopi kāme pasuto’.
cnd23:224.7: phoṭṭhabbe pariyesati taccarito tabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappono tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo, sopi kāmapasuto.
cnd23:224.12: phoṭṭhabbe paṭilabhati taccarito tabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappono tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo, sopi kāmapasuto’.
cnd23:224.17: phoṭṭhabbe paribhuñjati taccarito tabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappono tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo, sopi kāmapasuto’.
cnd23:224.18: yathā kalahakārako kalahapasuto, kammakārako kammapasuto, gocare caranto gocarapasuto, jhāyī jhānapasuto,
cnd23:224.19: evameva yo kāme esati gavesati pariyesati taccarito tabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappono tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyyo, sopi kāmapasuto.
cnd23:224.26: phoṭṭhabbe paribhuñjati, taccarito kabbahulo taggaruko tanninno tappono tappabbhāro tadadhimutto tadadhipateyye sopi kāmapasuko.
cnd23:224.28: pamādo vattabbo: kāyaduccarite vā vacīduccarite vā manoduccarite vā pañcasu kāmaguṇesu vā cittassa vossaggo vossaggānuppadānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanāya asakkaccakiriyatā asātaccakiriyatā anavaṭṭhitakiriyātā olīnavuttitā nikkhittachandatā nikkhittadhuratā anāsevanā abhāvanā abahulīkammaṃ anadhiṭṭhānaṃ ananuyogo pamādo. ‘yo evarūpo pamādo pamajjanā pamajjitattaṃ,
cnd23:225.1: sayaṃ na seve pasutaṃ pamattanti: pasutaṃ na seveyya pamattaṃ ca sayaṃ na seveyya, sāmaṃ na seveyya, na niseveyya, na saṃseveyya na paṭisaṃseveyya na ācareyya na samācareyya na samādāya vatteyyāti
cnd23:225.2: ‘sayaṃ na seve pasutaṃ pamattaṃ eko care khaggavisāṇakappo’.
cnd23:228.1: bahussutaṃ dhammadharaṃ bhajethaṃti bahussuto hoti mitto sutadharo suta sannicayo,
cnd23:228.2: ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā …pe… sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathā rūpāssa dhammaṃ bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā, manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
cnd23:228.4: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
